title: sftp ls JSON
description: Structured success payload for `ssh-cli sftp ls --json`.

agent_shape.description: Present only when a global shaping flag (--select, --filter, --limit, --sort, --dedupe-by, --count-only, --truncate-content or --max-output-bytes) reduced this envelope. It reports what the reduction did to the `entries` array.

input_count.description: items in the array before shaping

content_truncated.description: true when --truncate-content shortened at least one string

output_truncated.description: true when --max-output-bytes dropped items to fit the byte budget

count.description: Present only with --count-only, which replaces the `entries` array by the number of items left after the other shaping flags
